annotation_scope: Automated visual labels on selected native-rate source frames. Positive locations use centers of the visible shuttle/streak, not physical cork position. Not independent ground truth or a held-out benchmark. Three initially alleged racket examples were reclassified as visible shuttle observations after temporal inspection; selected candidate locations are not held-out labels.
